title: Pick an operation
description:
Write `BinaryOp pick(char symbol)` that returns a pointer to the function matching the symbol: `'+'` gives `add`, `'-'` gives `subtract`, `'*'` gives `multiply`. Any other symbol gives `nullptr`.

The alias `BinaryOp` (already written) hides the awkward pointer syntax.
lessonTitle: Function Pointers, Callbacks and Command-Line Arguments
